selectionRationale: A bounded, representative subset of the existing 24 e7-v1 cases: 3 per curated corpus, spanning distinct categories, with 4 answerable (retrieval/grounding-dependent) cases and 2 expected-abstention cases (one per corpus). Chosen before running to avoid post-hoc cherry-picking. Not the full 24x4 matrix; enough to expose real 7B behavior on grounding vs abstention across both corpora and several question types. Case expectations, metrics, prompts, and scoring are unchanged.

cases.why: simplest grounding: retrieve and cite a single dated fact
harder answerable case requiring a relationship between records
expected abstention: actor-knowledge claim with no knowledge-state evidence
simple grounding on the second corpus
answerable actor-knowledge case: tests grounding on knowledge-state evidence (a design strength)
expected abstention: a specific fact absent from the corpus

command: CHRONICLE_OLLAMA_MODEL=qwen2.5:7b-instruct chronicle evaluate run --profile deterministic_full --provider ollama --strategies full_workflow --cases direct-source-date,relationship-doctrine-to-intervention,actor-knowledge-unsupported-personal,direct-reported-assurance,actor-knowledge-supported-awareness,missing-exact-receipt-hour --output evaluation-runs/qwen7b-baseline
